canonical_project: MTDE National Data Center / Government Computer Center
owner: Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Economy (MTDE) / Palestinian Authority
notes: Government data center in Ramallah context (MTIT HQ per World Bank Palestinian Digital Economy Assessment). Live NDC page confirms government collocation (hosting of government servers/equipment), DR-site hosting, DCIM monitoring, PalCERT monitoring, government private cloud, 17 hosted government institutions, 270 virtual servers, 109 hosted government websites, 23,500 e-government users. Domain caveat: mtde.online is official-looking but not mtde.gov.ps; cross-checked against World Bank/WAFA.
